shared: Vines hang on a host unit and grow whenever it grows, so you buff the host, often another tribe's.
differ: How the vine copies: half down chains, everything but dying together, or once a turn from the back row.

takes.label: Trees of vines
takes.line: Climbers hang on climbers, so one buff trickles at half down a whole chain; Bloom makes tiny hosts like Ivy Shoots worth climbing.
takes.look_if: deep combo chains and several different ways to build.

takes.label: Rise and fall together
takes.line: Climbers copy their host's gains in full but can't be buffed otherwise and die with it; The Grand Oak carries three.
takes.look_if: a move-then-buff puzzle each turn with big swings.

takes.label: Back-row boosters
takes.line: Climbers sit in the three back slots and, each End of Turn, take half the biggest gain of the unit in front.
takes.look_if: board layout to decide things, backing another tribe's carry.
